title: Vibe Coding 101: How to Build Apps and More With AI | PCMag
summary: Vibe coding, a technique where AI generates and refines code, is gaining popularity among hobbyists and professionals for app and website development. Major companies like Google and Amazon are involved in the vibe-coding ecosystem, despite some incidents of AI tools causing unintended consequences.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive due to the growing adoption of vibe coding by major tech companies and its potential to democratize programming, despite some challenges and incidents.
